blind.description: A vintage-style dress form or tailor's dummy displayed on a short wooden turned base. The mannequin has a cream-colored torso and a wooden neck finial knob. It wears a burgundy/maroon period dress featuring a laced corset-style bodice, a flared pleated mid-length skirt, and a mustard-yellow draped sash or apron over the left hip with matching decorative ribbons near the collar. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with smooth surfaces and no detached or hovering pieces.
blind.from_above: Resembles a fluted, clover-like bell shape formed by the ruffled burgundy skirt, with the narrow cream shoulders and central round wooden knob clearly visible in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands approximately 4.2 to 4.5 feet tall (about 75% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), with the skirt flaring to roughly 2 feet in width.

notes: 1 separate piece(s) standing on the floor (20%)
